test_title: RRB Technician Grade 1 19 Dec 2024 Shift 3 Official Paper
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) EX-OK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48fa1bd3dc0dfdd573f311dee1aff67aed0da2b177f64756d58860f88485fbc7.png] 

Option 2) ZS-JF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/141fcf6089901e40d2ef0331625e8ae21d9937d62d02fc1fc696c00fbba80978.png] 

Option 3) IB-PO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9bd734d818f31f776e2c33c206bb93ed6486fdf0114eb7ea9d1382075a9fb4.png] 

Option 4) MF-WS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd7ae5a4d7dff61b1bba01b752cdc3819f37d11a2e2d69e4ba6e56d192b27f8.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'IB-PO' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer
